maps.name: Crystal Outpost
maps.blurb: A simple L-shaped lane — perfect for your first defense.

maps.name: Dust Ridge
maps.blurb: Four switchbacks with 2-row build lanes — room to dig in.

maps.name: North Pass
maps.blurb: A diagonal climb with wide landings — build in the wedges.

maps.name: Crosswind Valley
maps.blurb: Long beats, only 1 build row between lanes — tight placement.

maps.name: Broken Corridor
maps.blurb: A spiral with 2-tile build bands between coils.

maps.name: Shard Pocket
maps.blurb: Cramped spiral — 1-tile build rings, sharp turns.

maps.name: Wide Frontier
maps.blurb: Three long lanes with 4-row build belts — fortress density.

maps.name: Long March
maps.blurb: Endurance switchbacks with 2-row build lanes across a vast strip.

maps.name: Final Bastion
maps.blurb: Rim sweep then dive — 3-row courtyards for heavy batteries.
